      "title": "Prompt construction is defeating the existing feasibility gate because CX capacity is estimated on visible prompt chars while actual work includes hidden manufacturer prompt and pseudo-system parsing overhead",

Without a negative cache, the system keeps rediscovering that low-yield regions are low-yield, paying full xhigh CLI cost each time.",
